{{nihongo|'''Sengen Shrine (Shimoda)'''|浅間神社 (下田市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Sengen Shrine''' (せんげんじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Shimoda, Shizuoka|Q653402|qid=Q653402}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref name="jinjacho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401057 Sengen Shrine] – Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

Named after its locality, it is also known as '''Shimoda (Fuji) Sengen Shrine''' (しもだ(ふじ)せんげんじんじゃ) and '''Hongo (Fuji) Sengen Shrine''' (ほんごう(ふじ)せんげんじんじゃ), among other names.

=== Overview ===
The shrine is enshrined at the summit of the mountain called "{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shimoda Fuji}}" (しもだふじ), located very close to the northwest of {{ill|Izukyū Shimoda Station|Q6102244|qid=Q6102244}}. Visitors ascend via the approach (mountain trail) that begins along {{ill|Japan National Route 136|Q11421406|qid=Q11421406}} on the southern side.<ref>[https://izugeo13.sakuraweb.com/S-028-fuji.html Shimoda Fuji] – Izu Geo Heritage</ref><ref name="om">[https://humizuki.com/omaturi_zanmai/sight/jinja/simoda/sengen.htm Sengen Shrine] – Omatsuri Zanmai</ref>

Although the date of its founding is unknown, it is an ancient shrine that is considered to correspond to '''Ohayo-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (おはよのみことじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}. It is also recorded in the '{{ill|Izu Province Shrine Rank Register|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}' as “Junior Fourth Rank, Upper Grade: Ihayo-hime no Myōjin.”<ref name="om"/>
